description: Returns the internal rate of return for a series of periodic cash flows, considering both cost of investment and interest on reinvestment of cash.

params.description: A range or array of cells that contain numbers that represent a series of payments (negative) and income (positive) at regular periods.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The interest rate paid on the money used in the cash flows.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The interest rate received on the cash reinvestment.
params.name: arg3

signature: MIRR(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number[], arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
